page.content:
Villeneuve's sequel with K, Joi, and Wallace.

How Blade Runner 2049 connects

  • Creator: Denis Villeneuve — Denis Villeneuve directed Blade Runner 2049.
  • Character: Officer K — 2049 is Officer K's investigation.
  • Topic: Blade Runner — 2049 is the sequel that continues the city.
  • Location: Los Angeles 2049 — 2049 is set in the later Los Angeles.
  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — 2049 follows decades after the 1982 film.
  • Character: Joi — Joi is K's holographic companion in 2049.
  • Creator: Hampton Fancher — Fancher returned as a writer on 2049.

What is Blade Runner 2049?

Blade Runner 2049 follows Officer K, a replicant blade runner, through Wallace's new city, Joi's holographic companionship, and the secret of Deckard and Rachael's child.

Key threads lead to Denis Villeneuve, Officer K, Blade Runner, Los Angeles 2049, Blade Runner (1982) and Joi.
